subject: Texas AI Docket, Carousel No. 29, September 19th, 2026, Texas already had the power to ask
body:
Texas already had the power to ask

Carousel No. 29, September 19th, 2026

Shipped under target at 6.966 against 8.0

claimspass, 21 verified claim(s)
renderpass, 9 slide(s)
qapass, 9 slide(s), zero fails, zero warns
aggregatespass, 3 declaration(s), 3 numeric phrase(s) in the render, all re-derived
assemblypass, 9 slide(s), 61.77 MB, vector
scorestale, score.json predates the newest render, so it describes a deck that no longer exists. Re-run it
labelspass, 34 claim id(s) checked, every label beside one traces to the shape its claim proves
quantifierspass, 62 published string(s) read from one list, every universal names its set
verbatimpass, 2 declared fragment(s) over 1 of 9 dossier(s), every one a literal substring of its own claim's quote
dossierspass, 41,444 chars planned
captionpass, 139 words
craft floorpass, 9 frame(s), median 6841, floor 1231
plan vs renderwarn, 9 of 48 acceptance item(s) checkable
texanwarn, places NONE / body yes / deadline yes / next step yes
absencespass, 0 of 0 scoped to a named document
numeralspass, 3 numeral(s) over 9 frame(s), every one reachable
completionpass, the deck shipped

What degraded

  • the deck ships at a panel median of 6.966 against a 8.0 bar
    5 scoring rounds is the rubric's cap, and past it the bounded-search rule ships the deck at whatever the median is rather than grinding on it. The three judges read 6.89, 7.374, 6.87, a spread of 0.504, with no hard fail in the last three rounds. The number is stated rather than rounded, and the weakest criterion is variety at 5.5
  • the gate block's score row reads STALE
    score.json was written before the last re-render, so it describes a deck that no longer exists. Every other row in that block was regenerated against the shipped frames, and the panel's verdict on them is in the three judge files beside it
  • plan vs render could check 9 of 48 acceptance items
    most acceptance items are visual assertions no static reader can measure. The other 39 were read by the pixel critics frame by frame rather than by a gate, which is a person-shaped check standing in for a machine-shaped one
  • texan_check reads places NONE
    neither the directive nor the market notice names a county, a city or a volume of water. The deck names none either and carries its place on art alone, because inventing a locator to clear a warn would be a fact this run can't source
  • one fetch crossed the crawl boundary at capitol.texas.gov/TLODOCS/
    a scratch helper re-implemented the boundary as a tuple of hosts, and three of its four entries are hosts while that one is a path on a host otherwise allowed, so a host-level guard passed it by construction. Nothing from the fetch reached a claim, the record or a frame. The guard now checks paths too, case-insensitively, and the finding is in knowledge/shared/SOURCES_FIELD_LOG.md
  • the Supabase scanner ceiling check did not run
    no connector for it exists in this environment. That is not a failure of the check and it is not evidence the ceiling is fine
  • ledger/carousel/captions.json's exclusion lists are one shipped entry behind, for the third recorded time
    the caption room was briefed with a structure list omitting September 18th's, and a director was assigned a structure two days after it shipped. The critic caught it at the judging step rather than the briefing step, which cost the room its one rewrite. The fix changes two lanes at once so it stays a proposal in knowledge/carousel/UPGRADE_BACKLOG.md until a maintainer lands both halves
  • this is the fifth ERCOT request inside the dedupe window and dedupe_check can't see that
    it compares entities and keywords, and a repeat of the same INSTRUMENT is invisible to both. Four earlier run records have written this. The deck separates this notice from the Batch Zero request in the notice's own words
  • a local gate sweep reported nine green gates over a red one
    the loop printed $? after a command substitution, and bash had already overwritten it with basename's exit code. house_style_check was exiting 1 with 33 violations under a green banner. All 33 are fixed and the gate now reads clean across every page, but the sweep was wrong for as long as it ran

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Texas already had the power to ask, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

The survey was never optional.

On September 14th the Governor's office told the Texas Water Development Board to penalize past failures to file.

A data center that fails to complete and return the survey "commits an offense punishable as a crime". One that returns it late is "ineligible for TCEQ permits, amendments, or renewals". Neither consequence is new. The Texas Water Code already requires the survey and the permit bar sits in its Chapter 11.

The same day ERCOT issued a market notice carrying the board's own water questions. Answers are due October 12th.

The release states the board can't write a state water plan while it is denied detail on water consumption. The board's report on its enforcement progress is due to the Governor's office by October 14th. Does it name a single enforcement action?

#TWDB #ERCOT #TexasWaterCode

Notes

The record first. The selector named 126 items due for re-verification at wake and the worklist closed with 0 left. 4 items were admitted, tx-2026-0167, tx-2026-0171, tx-2026-0172, tx-2026-0173, taking the ledger to 149 items carrying 846 claims. The deck drew on 21 verified claims and the fact checker rejected 8. One of the rejections was the deck's own cover assertion, which round 1 caught as a hard fail and round 2 replaced with what the Water Code itself says. Machine QA reads zero fails and zero warns across 9 frames, and the PDF assembled vector at 61.77 MB. prompt_audit measured every tool call this run made and none waited on a human, so nothing stopped for a permission. This payload is committed before the merge rather than after it, because CI's email_check --all reads the committed email beside every shipped run, so a payload landing after its own merge leaves main red. The audit above therefore covers the run up to the push.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
